# Issue triage

`.github/workflows/issue-triage.yml` labels a new issue, asks for what the form requires and is missing, links likely duplicates and matches `[RED]` log lines against `docs/agents/symptoms.md`. It uses the GitHub Copilot CLI, so it runs on a Copilot subscription .

- **Setup:** add the Actions secret `COPILOT_TOKEN`: a fine-grained personal access token with only the account permission "Copilot Requests", from an account with Copilot. Without it the workflow skips with a notice.
- **Model:** set the repository variable `TRIAGE_MODEL` (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > Variables) to a model id the CLI accepts; it is passed as `--model`. Unset, the CLI uses GitHub's default. Recommended for triage: `claude-haiku-4.5`, a small fast model that is plenty for labels and a short comment. Models are billed differently: Copilot Pro on a monthly plan uses usage-based billing since 1 June 2026 (Haiku 4.5 is $1 per million input and $5 per million output tokens, [models and pricing](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/models-and-pricing)), and an annual plan that stayed on request-based billing counts a premium-request multiplier per model (Haiku 4.5 is 0.33; no model in that table counts 0, [multipliers](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/model-multipliers-for-annual-plans)). One triage is a prompt of a few thousand tokens and a few hundred tokens back.
- **Labels it uses:** `game`, `build`, `launcher`, `ios`, `mac`, `idea`, `question`, `needs-info`, `duplicate`. It only adds those that exist; it never creates one. `no-triage` on an issue skips it.
- **Re-run:** Actions > issue-triage > Run workflow with the issue number. The earlier triage comment is updated.
- **Security:** `gather` (read-only, no secrets) writes the data; `analyze` (no permissions, the model token) can only read in an empty directory; `apply` (`issues: write`, no model token) accepts only JSON of the fixed shape: labels from the list, at most one comment with no @-mention or HTML, links only into github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple and github.com/seedds/nxnative (judged on the normalised path; reference definitions, `//host` and bare domains are rejected), issue numbers only for the issue itself and the gathered duplicate candidates. It never closes or edits an issue.
- **Scripts:** `.github/scripts/triage_*.py` (standard library only), tests in `.github/scripts/tests`, the prompt in `.github/triage/prompt.md`.
